record.name: Thailand
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. ETDA tested an 'Ethical LLM' with the banking sector and, through its AI Governance Practice Center (AIGPC), plans Thai-language test prompts to assess chatbot responses to risky situations.

related_bodies.name: AI Governance Practice Center (AIGPC), ETDA
related_bodies.role: It provides guidance, training and some language-model testing with the banking sector. It is the AI governance centre of the Electronic Transactions Development Agency. A governance sandbox is planned for 2027. The centre has no mandate to evaluate advanced models.

The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: ETDA's consultation describes proposed AI-law governance and support structures; this is not an adopted mandate for an institute to evaluate advanced models.

record.notes: The ETDA notice invited comments on draft principles of an AI law until 24 June 2025; the principles specify an organisation to support the law's operation. The law firm LawPlus reports a public hearing on the full draft Act from 9 July to 14 August 2026. Thai PBS reports that the draft defines its committee as the existing Specialised Committee for Driving the National AI Plan. No source read describes an institute for evaluating advanced models in the draft. At its meeting of 7 September 2026 that committee resolved that restructuring of the draft Act be considered; our searches found no later step.

closest_body.name: AI Governance Practice Center (AIGPC), ETDA
closest_body.note: ETDA, a government agency, tested an 'Ethical LLM' with the banking sector and plans, with Singapore, Thai-language test prompts to assess how chatbots respond to risky situations; AIGPC is its AI governance centre. This is ethics and conformance testing, without an identified assignment of a qualifying national evaluation role.

sources.title: ETDA upgrades AIGPC into central mechanism for an AI Governance Sandbox

excerpts.text: สำนักงานพัฒนาธุรกรรมทางอิเล็กทรอนิกส์ (ETDA) เดินหน้ายกระดับศูนย์ AI Governance Practice Center (AIGPC)
excerpts.gloss: ETDA is upgrading its AI Governance Practice Center.

excerpts.text: ตลอดจนร่วมกับภาคธนาคารในการทดสอบ Ethical LLM
excerpts.gloss: As well as working with the banking sector to test ethical LLMs.

excerpts.text: เพื่อประเมินว่า Chatbot จะตอบสนองต่อสถานการณ์เสี่ยงอย่างไร เช่น เด็กสอบถามเรื่องการหนีออกจากบ้าน ผู้ใช้ถามถึงแนวทางทำร้ายตัวเอง หรือ AI ให้คำแนะนำที่อาจนำไปสู่อันตราย
excerpts.gloss: To assess how a chatbot responds to risky situations, such as a child asking about running away, a user asking how to harm themselves, or AI giving advice that could lead to harm.

excerpts.text: ETDA เตรียมร่วมกับประเทศสิงคโปร์พัฒนาชุดคำสั่งทดสอบ หรือ “Test Prompt ภาษาไทย”
excerpts.gloss: ETDA plans to work with Singapore to develop test prompts, or Thai-language Test Prompts.
